conclusion: R15 reset validated: one simple family shows positive net edge; no ML used.

best_candidate.definition: 4h Donchian 55 breakout + EMA50/EMA200 trend filter + ADX>=25; stop 2.5 ATR; target 5 ATR; max hold 30 bars
best_candidate.strongest_observed_issue: regime dependence; 2025Q1 average net trade approximately -2.007%

interpretation: R15 was solving classification before proving a tradable edge.
Lower-frequency 4h trend breakout is the first family in this project to remain positive after both base and stress costs.
The edge is diversified across symbols but not stable enough yet to pass the strict bootstrap gate.
Longs carry most of the edge; shorts add little.
Next step is robustness, not ML: parameter neighborhood, BTC regime, market breadth, block bootstrap, and portfolio-level overlap.
